gfs_archive.note: the archive fetch keeps only the IMD-day boundary hours: no sub-daily rain

gfs_live_raw.note: 3-hourly cumulative APCP f003..f096 per cycle (NOMADS grib filter, domain crop)

ecmwf_day_files.note: IMD-day totals only: HRES and the ensemble mean / p10 / p50 / p90; members and sub-daily steps not kept

definitions.forecast_maps: GFS 3-hour blocks regridded bilinearly to 0.1 degree, then max3h, max6h (two consecutive blocks), wet_hours (3 h per block of at least 0.3 mm); max1h is the 3-hour maximum (no sub-3-hour step)
definitions.late_maps: complete IMERG Late half-hourly days reduced by imerg_hh.reduce_day (rolling 1/3/6 h windows)
definitions.early_maps: the first 44 IMERG Early half-hours of the day (what the 11:00 IST run has)
definitions.quantiles: each side's own percentile over the pairs (frequency matched, not paired)
